[[Spirit of Truth]] | type = [[Reward trophy]] }} The [[Stygian Gemstone]] is one of a set of 4 [[gemstone]]s used to obtain either a [[Coffer of Whispers]] or [[Armbrace of Truth]]. {{TOCright}} ==Acquisition== *[[Domain of Anguish]] **[[Stygian Veil]] ***[[Stygian Brute]] ***[[Stygian Fiend]] ***[[Stygian Golem]] ***[[Stygian Horror]] ***[[Stygian Hunger]] ***[[Stygian Lord]] ***[[Stygian Underlord (ranger)]] ***[[Stygian Underlord (dervish)]] ***[[Stygian Chest]] ==Chests== A [[Stygian Chest]] spawns every time The [[Dreadspawn Maw]] is defeated. The chest contains 1-8 {{PAGENAME}}s for each party member, depending on how many [[lords of anguish|Lords of Anguish]] have been defeated so far and the game mode you are in. ==Quests== *[[Mallyx the Unyielding (quest)|Mallyx the Unyielding]] *[[Money Back Guarantee]] ==Collectors== {{:Keeper of Whispers/Collector}} {{:Spirit of Truth/Collector}} ==Notes== *Beware of [[scam]]s as it shares the skin as a [[Stone of the Elements]]. {{Reward trophies nav}} [[Category:Domain of Anguish gemstones]] [[Category:Rare trophies]] [[Category:Items with shared icons]]
